meta.name: Personal Design Standard
meta.description: Master design specification. Pick one 'styleVariant' per project. Everything under 'core' applies no matter which variant is chosen.
howToUse: 1. Copy this file into every new project as /design/standard.json
2. Choose ONE key from styleVariants (neobrutalism | claymorphism | minimalism)
3. Merge core.* with styleVariants.<chosen>.* — the variant overrides core where they conflict
4. Pick light or dark from colorSystem.modes as the default, but both must always be implemented
5. Pick one pairing from typography.pairings based on project tone

principles: Consistency over novelty — reuse tokens, never hand-pick one-off values
Accessible by default — never ship a contrast ratio below WCAG AA
Hierarchy through scale and weight, not just color
Every interactive element has a visible focus, hover, and active state
Whitespace is a design element, not leftover space
Dark mode is not an inverted afterthought — it is designed, not auto-generated
core.elevationPrinciple: Elevation communicates interactivity/hierarchy, not decoration. Shadow direction and softness change per styleVariant.

motion.philosophy: Motion confirms cause and effect. Nothing animates without a reason.

colorSystem.structure: neutral scale + single accent color, always shipped in both light and dark

accent.description: Single accent color per project — swap the hex, keep the ramp math (base ±tint/shade)
accent.usage: Reserve accent for primary actions, key highlights, and focus states only. Never use accent for large background fills.

dark.accent: accent.placeholderBase (lighten 10% for AA contrast on dark)

typography.philosophy: Elegant by default; pick the pairing that matches project seriousness.

neobrutalism.color: high contrast neutrals + one loud accent, large flat fills allowed
neobrutalism.components: visible thick borders, blocky buttons, sticker-like tags

border.width: 0px, borders implied by shadow/light not lines

shadow.style: dual shadow: soft light highlight (top-left) + soft dark shadow (bottom-right)
shadow.onHover: shadow depth increases slightly, no hard edges

claymorphism.color: pastel/muted fills, low-contrast gradients within same hue
claymorphism.typographyWeight: medium/semibold headings, regular body, rounded font preferred
claymorphism.components: pill buttons, puffy cards, no sharp corners anywhere

minimalism.description: Maximum restraint, content-first, structure via whitespace

shadow.style: near-none; use 1 soft ambient shadow max for elevation

minimalism.color: near-monochrome, accent used extremely sparingly (single CTA)
minimalism.typographyWeight: light/regular headings, generous line-height, type IS the hierarchy
minimalism.components: no visible containers where possible, dividers over boxes, generous whitespace over borders

input.errorColor: must not rely on red alone — pair with icon/text
